## Summary

The running status should use the same twelve-character revision identifier as history so users can match deployments consistently.

## Changes

## Important
- app/display.py:14 — correctness — Use the history revision length in running status — For revision `0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567`, running status displays `0123456`, while history displays `0123456789ab`. Your new `revision[:7]` contradicts the docstring’s promise to use “the same identifier as history,” which uses `revision[:12]`. — Users receive inconsistent identifiers across deployment views, and revisions sharing seven characters become indistinguishable in running status.
